text: In 1985, at the height of the video nasty panic, Enid Baines works as a film censor, cutting violence with quiet perfectionism, while her parents declare [her long-missing sister Nina legally dead|wrong|loss that won't heal]. When a tabloid blames her for a family's murder, the phone calls start. Then [a producer invites her to screen an old horror film|trigger|seeing or hearing too much] that seems to replay Nina's disappearance, and in its star, Alice Lee, Enid sees [the sister she means to rescue|wants|getting back the lost], as [the screen and her life begin to blur|ending|taken to the other side].
